name: area-3d-mockups-monorepo
description: Monorepo for area-3d-mockups: interactive, GPU-accelerated 3D device mockups for React. Framework-agnostic core + the React binding.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @area-3d-mockups/core && npm run build -w area-3d-mockups && npm run build -w docs
scripts.dev: concurrently -n pkg,docs -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w area-3d-mockups" "npm run dev -w docs"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @area-3d-mockups/core && npm run typecheck -w area-3d-mockups && npm run typecheck -w docs
